exact: cellular response to oleoyl lysophosphatidic acid

definition: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a 1-oleoyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate stimulus.
label: cellular response to 1-oleoyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate
